title: Bhima and Bakasura
notes: Ep 09/10 bar tokens. Comic mythology Amar Chitra — never photoreal. Bhima continuity: largest Pandava, saffron-yellow dhoti, thick mustache, topknot, no peacock. Bakasura fierce but stylized, no gore. Local locks under stills/_locks/ must be regenerated at 1536×1024 (current bhima/bakasura locks are 720p archive).

bhima.face: Young adult Pandava warrior, broad jaw, dark eyes, thick dark mustache, confident calm — comic mythology, not photoreal
bhima.hair: Black curly warrior topknot — no peacock feather, no Ep 09 Arjuna gold battle mukut
bhima.costume: Saffron-yellow dhoti with gold border, bare powerful chest, simple armbands — largest of the Pandavas

bakasura.face: Rakshasa (Vaka): large, fierce but stylized comic features — not photoreal horror
bakasura.hair: Wild dark hair, optional small horns or rough topknot
bakasura.costume: Dark forest greens and browns, ragged warrior cloth, towering stature still equal comic mythology scale

kunti.face: Mature noble mother, warm brown skin, serene resolve — painted comic, not photoreal
kunti.hair: Dark hair with simple gold ornaments — no peacock
kunti.costume: Saffron or cream sari with gold border

brahmin_father.face: Middle-aged brahmin householder, distressed but dignified — comic mythology
brahmin_father.costume: White cotton dhoti and upper cloth

townsfolk.face: Background comic villagers — not photoreal portraits
townsfolk.costume: Muted village dress, equal natural human scale
